title: Parallax Shift - Locked Horizon
description: A surreal illustrated landscape divided into distinct horizontal bands. The top shows a blue mountain range with a winding river and three floating horse-like creatures. The middle band features arid brown hills with a central red glowing structure labeled 'The Locked Core' emitting radial light beams. The bottom displays lush green terrain with a circular stone city labeled 'The Eternal Verge' and a dark spire labeled 'The Last Watch' with radiating lines.
prompt: Detailed fantasy illustration showing a vertical cross-section of a surreal world divided into three distinct horizontal layers. Top layer: blue mountains and winding river with three floating horse-like beings in the sky. Middle arid brown desert layer features a glowing red cubic structure labeled The Locked Core emitting bright radial beams. Bottom lush green valley contains a large circular stone city labeled The Eternal Verge and a dark spire labeled The Last Watch with energy lines. Title at bottom reads PARALLAX SHIFT - Stage of the Locked Horizon. Vintage painted aesthetic with decorative border elements.
